gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with histologically confirmed advanced or metastatic solid tumor's (excluding central nervous system tumors other than IDHwt glioblastoma)

candidate_evidence.quote: S095035 is an oral methionine adenosyltransferase 2A \[MAT2A\] inhibitor. TNG462 is a protein arginine N-methyltransferase 5 \[PRMT5\] inhibitor.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: who have failed to respond to or have progressed after at least 1 prior treatment regimen, and for whom additional effective standard treatment is not available

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Area under the concentration-vs-time curve (AUC) from 0 to time of last measurable concentration (AUC0-t): Phase 1 and 2

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Change from baseline in plasma concentrations of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) and/or tumor symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA) residues during treatment: Phase 1 only

role_evidence.quote: S095035 will be taken orally every day in 28-day cycles.
S095035 as single-agent, or in combination with TNG462

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: MAT2A inhibitor in MTAP-deleted tumours (synthetic lethality with PRMT5)
arms: Phase 1 Arm 1 - S095035 single-agent dose escalation
Phase 1 Arm 2 - S095035-TNG462 combination dose escalation
Phase 2 Arm 1a NSCLC - S095035 single-agent dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 1b BTC - S095035 single-agent dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 1c PDAC - S095035 single-agent dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 1d Basket arm - S095035 single-agent dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 2a BTC - S095035-TNG462 combination dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 2b Gastroesophageal - S095035-TNG462 combination dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 2c PDAC - S095035-TNG462 combination dose expansion

role_evidence.quote: TNG462 will be taken orally every day in 28-day cycles.

arms: Phase 1 Arm 2 - S095035-TNG462 combination dose escalation
Phase 2 Arm 2a BTC - S095035-TNG462 combination dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 2b Gastroesophageal - S095035-TNG462 combination dose expansion
Phase 2 Arm 2c PDAC - S095035-TNG462 combination dose expansion

source_quote.quote: Participants with pre-existing documented MTAP homozygous gene deletion in their tumor tissue, determined using a next generation sequencing in vitro diagnostic test prior to screening.
with measurable disease as per RECIST 1.1 or RANO 2.0 criteria for participants with IDHwt glioblastoma

who have a pre-existing, documented cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 2A (CDKN2A) homozygous gene deletion in their tumor tissue (confirmed by an NGS IVD test), but do not have homozygous MTAP deletion reported
Change from baseline in plasma concentrations of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) and/or tumor symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA) residues during treatment: Phase 1 only

coder_notes: Basket of MTAP-deleted solid tumours; glioblastoma named in inclusion criteria only as IDHwt glioblastoma (CNS tumours otherwise excluded). Role of S095035 differs by arm: single agent in single-agent arms (coded experimental_monotherapy), investigational partner of TNG462 in combination arms; regimen coded combination because combination arms exist. CDKN2A deletion is used only as a pre-screening aid for China participants, MTAP deletion still being confirmed, so not coded as an entry requirement. PK sample type not stated.
